REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is our ORIGINAL massive Stronglav: use its recognizable powerful head, predatory heavy brow, great muscular bulk, tall long-legged proportions and huge clawed hands as the identity foundation. Its aggressive crouched pose, dark colors, four thick tentacles and bare pelvis are OLD designs, replaced by the specification below.
Image 2 is the ORIGINAL A.R.E.A. albino color source: take the pale dirty ivory / ash-gray / subtle pink flesh palette and small red eyes. Do not copy its thin body, front T-pose, polygonal mesh, editor grid or guide lines.

FINAL CHARACTER:
A unique approximately three-meter-tall ancient sentient apex predator, a much larger and more powerfully built relative of a Bloodsucker. Broad massive chest and shoulders, strong neck, huge muscular arms and hands, very long powerful legs. Mature imposing anatomy with coherent natural muscles, no bloated toy-like forms. Strong thoughtful predatory face under a heavy brow, not gaunt or childlike. Small red eyes with subtle restrained luminosity. Pointed elf-like leathery ears projecting visibly out of the head hair.

POSE AND VIEW:
Stand completely UPRIGHT and CALMLY, with straight strong back, level broad shoulders, head held high, both arms lowered naturally beside the body, heavy relaxed clawed hands pointing down, long nearly straight legs and grounded feet in a subtle natural stagger. Convey ancient intelligence, patience and immense controlled strength. No lunge, roar, threatening reach or attack pose. Body and head in a readable left-facing three-quarter SIDE VIEW, watchful eyes directed at an unseen player to the LEFT, not at the camera.

MOUTH TENTACLES:
Many individually drawn VERY THIN flexible tendrils, approximately eighteen, hanging as a long beard and two lateral mustache strands to the chest. Pale ivory/light gray-pink shafts match his skin. ONLY the last small part of each intact tendril is crimson red, ending in a small sharp integrated organic red stinger. Slender fine pointed stingers, not giant blades. THREE of the tendrils are shorter at different lengths, showing ancient lost tips: dry pale rounded or puckered CLOSED scar tissue at their ends, no red stinger on those three and no open cross-section, raw stump or fresh blood. The remaining tendrils stay long and intact. Use graceful organic curves, clear individual strands and small gaps, not a solid tangled blob.

HAIR:
Thick coarse flowing SCALP HAIR, swept back from the face and falling along the neck; thick shaggy PELVIC/GROIN HAIR growing naturally around the pelvis, covering the crotch/front/rear and draping in irregular locks almost to the knees. It is natural hair, not a cloth garment. ALL actual hair has SILVER-GRAY/WHITE ROOTS transitioning down each lock to very DARK DESATURATED SWAMP-GREEN ENDS. Real believable fine fibers grouped in natural locks. No hair on chest, arms, hands, lower legs or feet. Mouth tentacles are flesh, not hair.

SKIN, SCARS AND EXTREMITIES:
Natural pale albino skin with subtle uneven gray-pink tones, organic pores, fine wrinkles, slight translucency and a mostly MATTE finish. Many old battle scars from bullets, cuts and bites, fully healed: pale slightly raised or recessed irregular lines, closed puckered scar tissue; no red raw cuts, fresh wounds or black open holes. Localized old dark blood stains on HANDS, fingers and hand claws.
Feet have recognizable HUMAN anatomy: heels, arches and FIVE flesh-covered human-shaped toes per foot, one broad inner big toe with four successively smaller toes. Sharp dark horn claws grow naturally from each toenail bed. Feet and toe claws are CLEAN with no blood. No exposed genitals.
NO chitin, armor plates, horns, spines, external spinal ridge, clothes, weapons or props.

RENDERING QUALITY:
Fresh professional realistic dark survival-horror character concept art, precise anatomical drawing, refined tactile organic materials, soft coherent directional illumination, excellent local definition without sharpening halos. Skin must NOT look like polished plastic, glass, a faceted gemstone, marble, metallic rubber or a tiled reptile scale pattern. No duplicated scars, smeared retouch patches or oversaturated pink highlights. Clearly differentiated matte skin, dry fibrous scars, coarse hair, flexible flesh tendrils and horn claws. Preserve readable shadows and natural color. Newly compose all details coherently.

One complete creature alone in a high-resolution vertical full-body composition. Leave generous clear transparent padding around the head hair, all hands, toe claws and tendril tips; absolutely no cropping.
TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA ALPHA, including fine gaps between hair/tendrils/limbs. No environment, gray plane, floor, cast ground shadow, opaque background, vignette, haze, simulated checkerboard, text, labels or watermark.

Make one precise finishing correction to this NEWLY DRAWN Stronglav illustration. Preserve its clean natural realistic rendering, matte organic skin texture, anatomy, lighting, silhouette, pose, hair and all other details. Do NOT restyle, sharpen, smooth, add scaly patterns or rebuild the character.

Correct ONLY these three local details:
1. HEALED SHORTENED TENTACLE ENDS: the few short mouth tentacles currently show red circular cut cross-sections. 2. OLD BODY SCARS: the long scars on the forehead, shoulder, chest, arms and legs currently have dark red groove-like centers.
